name: John S. Carter
role: Member of the first Kirtland high council
dateNote: Section 102 lists him on the high council organized in February 1834; he died that June in Missouri.
importance: John S. Carter joined about 1832 in Vermont and preached there with his brother Jared. Section 102 lists him among the twelve councilors of the first Kirtland high council in 1834. He then marched with the camp to Missouri. He died in Clay County, Missouri, in late June 1834.
connections: He was a brother of Jared Carter and Simeon D. Carter.

sources.title: John Sims Carter, Joseph Smith Papers biography

reviewNote: Dates checked on JSP; death 25/26 June 1834 in Clay Co. JSP does not state the cause of death, so none is given here.
